mapping: Unique modal named work-related town, at least 5 distinct baseline households per district; unmatched=unknown; no outcomes used. Includes all baseline survey households as fixed contextual covariates, including held-out districts.
limitations: Past travel by current district residents does not establish origin-to-destination migration flows, neighbouring districts, commuting catchments, or child migration. Other urban destinations excluded rather than guessed. Same children reused; exploratory.
